entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'd like to start a return for a VeloBand Cadence Sensor I purchased.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and the order number?
Sure, the name is Alex Miller, and the order number is VF887162.
Thank you, Alex. I have your order right here. So I can best assist you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the sensor? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?
It's a preference thing, it works fine. The main problem is that I'm now outside the return window, but I did try to return it about three weeks ago, on my ninth day of owning it.
I see. Okay, one moment. My records show the item was delivered 29 days ago. What happened when you tried to process the return initially?

That's right. I went to your website, but I kept getting a 'website error' message on the returns page. The whole system was down for hours. I couldn't print the label or even get the process to start. I actually took a screenshot because I was worried this might happen.

I appreciate you explaining that, Alex. Let me check my notes here... Ah, yes. You're absolutely right. It looks like we had a known server outage that day which affected the returns portal. I'm very sorry you had to deal with that.

Good news though, you don't even need an exception. Our policy actually allows for returns up to 90 days from delivery. You're still well within that timeframe, so I can process this for you right now. No problem at all.

Oh, 90 days? That's great to hear. Well, thank you for approving it. I do appreciate that. Since I did spend a good bit of time trying to get it done during that system outage, and now had to call in, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my trouble?

That is an excellent question, and I completely understand. Given the confirmed website error and the fact that you're a VIP member with us, I can absolutely do that. I've just added a 20% credit to your account, which will apply automatically to your next purchase. I'll also email you the return shipping label immediately.
Wow, a 20% credit is perfect. Thank you, Charlie. That's more than fair. I really appreciate your help with this.
You're very welcome, Alex. It was my pleasure to help. The email with the label and confirmation of the credit is on its way to you now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Have a great day, and thank you for being a VeloFit customer.
